trips.name: The Ambassador
trips.note: The Ambassador: Montreal 8.20 a.m. by the Central Vermont to White River Jct. 1.40 p.m., the Boston & Maine on to Boston (North Station) 5.50 p.m. The New York section leaves White River Jct. 1.50 p.m. (No. 74-59, on_cn_t051n). Motor coach for Stowe at Waterbury; Burlington and Montpelier by motor coach. To Boston. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

trips.name: The Ambassador
trips.note: The Ambassador: Boston (North Station) 11.30 a.m. by the Boston & Maine to White River Jct. 3.05 p.m. (joined there by the New York section, No. 66-77), the Central Vermont to Montreal 8.30 p.m. From Boston. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

Daily: Quebec 10.20 p.m. to Riviere a Pierre 12.20 a.m. (there the Montreal cars of No. 211 join No. 211, below), Chambord 6.05 / 6.20 a.m. and Chicoutimi 9.15 a.m.; Dolbeau: No. 193 (on_cn_t055.csv). Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

Daily sleeping-car train (printed 163-211): from Montreal (Central Station) 7.00 p.m. (Sundays 6.00 p.m.; on_cn_t050m.csv) and the Quebec cars of No. 163; Riviere a Pierre 1.00 a.m. to Chambord 5.15 / 5.30 and Chicoutimi 7.30 a.m. Stops at any station between Riviere a Pierre and Chicoutimi for sleeping-car passengers. From Montreal. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

trips.name: The Ambassador
trips.note: The Ambassador's New York section: White River Jct. 1.50 p.m. (from No. 332) by the Boston & Maine (No. 74) to Springfield 5.23 p.m. and the New Haven (No. 59) to New York (Grand Central) 9.08 p.m.. To New York. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

trips.name: The Ambassador

From New York. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

trips.name: The Washingtonian
trips.note: The Washingtonian: Montreal 7.40 p.m. by the Central Vermont to White River Jct. 12.30 a.m., on as Boston & Maine No. 732 to Springfield 3.45 a.m. and New Haven No. 169 to New York (Pennsylvania Station) 7.10 a.m. and Washington 12.10 p.m. Its Boston cars leave White River Jct. 3.00 a.m. in B. & M. No. 302 (with the Red Wing's, on_cp_t024r). Burlington and Montpelier / Barre by motor coach from Essex Jct. and Montpelier Jct. (not entered). To Washington. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

trips.name: The Vermonter

trips.name: The Montrealer

From Washington. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.
